column1: # PICASO 4.1 (Batalha et al. 2019, ApJ 878, 70): the GPI K1 (SVO Gemini/GPI.K1) intensity of Exo-REM cloudy (Charnay et al. 2018, ApJ 854, 172; 3.16 times solar metallicity, C/O 0.35) structures (https://lesia.obspm.fr/exorem/YGP_grids/old_grids_2021/), the optical depth and particle radius of the iron and silicate clouds the release states for each layer, and Exo-REM's optical constants of both,
# with PICASO's resampled opacity database opacities.db (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3759675), energy-weighted over PICASO's bins,
# solved with four-term spherical harmonics (Rooney, Batalha & Marley 2023, arXiv:2304.04830),
# at the emission cosines of its eight Gauss points; a and b are the least-squares quadratic law with the centre intensity free.
